title: cad-to-html manifest
description: Joints, materials and display options for one model. Coordinates are in the model's assembly (root) frame at rest, in millimetres. Part references (part_ids, part_materials keys) are tree.json node ids, or node/part names; part_materials keys may use * and ? globs.

color.description: Optional display colour override for parts of this material.

part_materials.description: Node id / node name / part name (globs allowed) -> material name. First match wins.

default_density.description: g/cm^3 for parts without a material.

up.description: Model up axis. CAD is usually Z-up.

explode_scale.description: Explode distance multiplier at slider max.

part_colors.description: Part id or name -> colour override.

review_notes.description: Free-form notes (e.g. from the auto-guesser) for a human to review. Ignored by the viewer.

type.description: hinge: rotation about axis through pivot, limited to [min, max] degrees. slider: translation along axis, [min, max] mm. free: unlimited rotation about axis through pivot (degrees).

part_ids.description: Nodes that move together. An assembly id moves all its parts. A joint whose parts include all of another joint's parts acts as that joint's parent (the child joint's axis rides along).

axis.description: Direction (need not be unit length). Positive values rotate right-handed about it / translate along it.

pivot.description: Point on the rotation axis (hinge/free). Ignored for sliders.

default.description: Value on load (default 0, clamped to limits).
